summary: Orla Mining filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of its business combination with Equinox Gold, creating a combined senior gold producer with ~1.1 Moz annual output. The transaction had been previously announced; terms (price/share, premium) are not stated in this excerpt. Ross Beaty stepped down as Chairman, becoming Chairman Emeritus; Chuck Jeannes appointed incoming Chairman. CEO Darren Hall will retire October 31, 2026, succeeded by Jason Simpson. The filing confirms closing and leadership changes. What to watch: integration execution and production ramp toward 1.9 Moz guidance.
